page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of memory per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its substantial local storage capacity, which consists of 23,038 GB of local SSD storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

Given the high density of both local SSD storage and memory relative to the 104 dedicated vCPUs, this instance offers qualitative resource efficiency for workloads requiring massive local data retention and high-throughput I/O. The hardware profile is designed for large-scale databases, data warehousing, big data analytics, and storage-intensive enterprise applications that benefit from direct-attached solid-state storage and high-capacity memory without requiring GPU acceleration.
